method: scripts/eval/measure-overview-latency.mjs; read-only Airtable GETs using the current split repository query shape

core.description: One organization-scoped Events query used by GET /overview/core.

activity.description: Organization-scoped event discovery followed by six parallel scoped secondary reads used by GET /overview/activity.

historicalBeforeRemediation.description: The prior monolithic probe observed 2920 ms and 1110 ms wall samples before core/activity separation. Those diagnostic samples are retained only as historical context and are not current or release evidence.

sourceEvidence: Core and activity are separate authorized routes.
Core awaits only the scoped Events query.
Activity secondary reads run in parallel after scoped event discovery.
The browser starts both reads independently and retains same-organization snapshots on refresh failure.
limitations: This is one local read-only sample per split endpoint shape, not a percentile distribution.
It does not measure browser rendering, the Next gateway, Worker execution, network geography, or production load.
The development fixture is sparse; these values do not prove the public performance targets or deployed release readiness.
No production or staging credential, tenant payload, or provider response is stored in this artifact.
